There are two strategies to gain this achievement: 1) kite this champion around and break any cocoon that she will throw at you, or 2) do all your damage at melee range (so you do not get cocooned). Pets and other minions can be targeted by the enemy as well so it's best to not take those with you. To gain this achievement Queen can't even get close to the cocoons or the progress will be lost. This achievement can also be obtained in a Private Squad, which can be easier if trying to coordinate players to stay close together.

Cite: ^ Tiptoe: There are four groups of hillbillies in this zone. The first are avoided prior to checkpoint 7 (by simply heading to the right, towards the frogger-style log jumping rapids). Doing this avoids the second group which are hidden in a cave beneath the Raccoon Kingpin's maze. The only group of hillbillies requiring to actively be avoided are the third group, found just after the frogger-style log jumping area, and just prior to checkpoint 8 - they can be avoided by hopping up onto a ledge just to the right of Shop #4, and then hugging the left-hand wall prior to checkpoint 8. The fourth group to avoid are in the area to the right after the last checkpoint (where the vending machine is found) - avoided by heading straight for the boss and ignoring that diversion too.

Name: Rift Striker

TypeValue.GameText: Help close lingering rifts across Tyria.

Cite: ^ Rift Striker: Every 10 minutes a Rift appears in seven zones across Tyria. Break the Rift's shield by standing in the spot where the shard projectiles will land to catch them, and then use them next to the shield. After four shards have been used, the shield goes down and you can walk up to the rift and enter to travel to a Mists Rift.

TypeValue.GameText: Destroy a remnant Awakened champion.

Cite: ^ Reawakening Threat: Defeat one of the champions coming out of the portal during Defeat the invading Awakened.

Name: Portal Peacemaker

TypeValue.GameText: Help Ninn construct a Phasic Distortion Reader to detect the Awakened portal invasions.

Cite:
^ Portal Peacemaker: After completing one of the invasions, you will receive a mail from Mechanist Ninn asking to meet you in your Home instance. He'll ask you to retrieve:

50
Mithril Ingot
3
Charged Quartz Crystal


1
Resonance Tuner
1
Etheric Tank
1
Gate Alchemeter

Resonance Tuner - Speak to Glaxx at  Ulta Metamagicals Waypoint — . He should send you north to Enrav Exploration Post and you can retrieve it from the Asura Device Container there.
Etheric Tank - Speak to Danka in the asura lab at  Valance Tutory Waypoint — . She will sell you the Etheric Tank for 2 .
Gate Alchemeter - Speak to Gate Operator Stebben at the Asura Gate in Stronghold of Ebonhawke (closest waypoint:  Hawkgates Waypoint — ). You should be sent into Last Stand Shelter to retrieve it from the Asura Device Container in the back of the cave.
Return to Ninn with all the items and talk to him to hand them over. He will ask for a day to build the device for you (daily reset). (Note: If your character is an Engineer, an Asura, or a Charr with the Iron Legion biography selected, you will have the opportunity to help him build the device, in which case you receive it immediately instead of waiting for daily reset).

TypeValue.GameText: Acquire diving goggles near the gate of fire, and dive into the bucket floating in the boiling sea.
TypeValue.GameHint: Just a casual dip in another hollow volcano.

Cite: ^ Hot Splashes: From  Heathen's Hold Waypoint — , take the northwest  Thermal Tube up toward Titan's Throat. Although the description hints that the goggles are near the Gate of Fire, they are located much closer to  Searing Ascent — , on the edge of the ledge at the start of the  Searing Ascent jumping puzzle. The bucket to dive into is in the boiling sea at the very bottom of Titan's Throat, just north of the  Searing Ascent icon. Fall directly off the edge, passing the first ledge, then veer slightly left through a small gap between the crystal and the ledge just before the sea.

Name: Smashing!

TypeValue.GameHint: Defeat Ellutherius Wintergust without being hit by his pot attacks, three consecutive times.

Cite: ^ Smashing!: The Pot Attacks are denoted by small red AoE circles on the ground, in which several pots fall in quick succession for a few seconds. It is important to note you do not have to actually dodge the attack - you just have to take no damage from it, which can be achieved by simply keeping out of the AoE circles (no dodge rolls necessary). When the attack ends, if you took no damage from the pots, you'll gain a stack of Ceramics Evasion, up to 3 of them. You'll lose all stacks if you take damage from a Pot Attack, or if you get downed. If you end the fight with 3 stacks of Ceramics Evasion, you will unlock the achievement.

"A sacred weapon is held in the boughs of great trees, never to be turned against them." Albax spoke of the verdant sights of the Maguuma Jungle.
"The needy hold tight to a hope of plenty in a pitiless golden land." Albax cringed while thinking of the heat in the Crystal Desert.

Name: Heart, Moxie, and Many Sweaters

TypeValue.GameText: Survive 20 stacks of Bitter Cold.

Cite:
^ Heart, Moxie, and Many Sweaters: 
 Bug:
Heart, Moxie, and Many Sweaters does not require the player to be alive when they have 20 stacks of Bitter Cold. Bitter Cold accumulates even when defeated, so simply being in a Bitter Cold area long enough will grant the achievement. Player tested on 11/28/22: This seems to have been patched, but you can still die and accumulate 20 stacks, then use a Revive Orb to get the achievement. Alternately, Bitter Cold will also need to whittle through a mount's lifebar if you enter while mounted, which can be used to extend your own exposure time to hopefully accumulate enough stacks. Update 31/05/2025: With the ability to mount Skyscale or Warclaw in combat, you can switch to either when you are dropped, making it easy to achieve the achievement.

Cite: ^ Gift of Aurene: Components for the Gift of Aurene collection can be bought and sold on the Trading Post. Each part can only be crafted once per day per account, on the standard daily reset. The parts are tradable, but the complete doll is account-bound.

Name: Dive Master: Cold Feet

TypeValue.GameText: Find and use a diving location in the Bitter Cold.

Cite:
^ Dive Master: Cold Feet: There are several Diving Goggles placed around the Bitter Cold area. All of them are placed above solid ice. To be successful, you must use the highest one, in the southeastern corner of the area. This one will allow you to safely break through the ice to the water below; aim for the obvious patch of ice. There is also an Icebound Chest in the water below the dive point. Using any of the other dive points will result in the ice not breaking and you taking falling damage.

 Bug:
After using the highest goggles to dive and break through the ice, the impact may still kill you in the water, and you will not receive the achievement. If this occurs, a workaround is to break the ice first with a mount to take the fall damage, or by bringing somebody else, before diving into the water.
